title: ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.29722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large, diverse, and high-quality datasets are significant for advancing AI in requirements engineering, yet automated identification of requirements from Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) remains a challenge. Automatic Requirements Identification (ARI) methods demonstrate limited generalization to unseen documents across heterogeneous SRSs. This work presents ReqSeek, a transformer-based, domain-agnostic ARI model for recognizing ISO 29148-style requirements in SRS documents, supporting dataset construction. We curated the Automatic Requirements Identification Dataset (ARID), comprising 2,396 training instances from 23 heterogeneous SRSs, and fine-tuned four transformer architectures. RoBERTa was selected as the base model for ReqSeek and achieved 95% precision, recall, F1, and F0.89 on the held-out evaluation set. translated_title: ReqSeek：基于Transformer的自动需求识别方法，用于构建大规模需求数据集
translated_abstract: 大规模、多样化且高质量的数据集对于推动需求工程领域的人工智能发展至关重要，然而从软件需求规格说明（SRS）中自动识别需求仍是一项挑战。现有的自动需求识别（ARI）方法在异构SRS文档上对未见文档的泛化能力有限。本工作提出了ReqSeek，一个基于Transformer、与领域无关的自动需求识别模型，用于识别SRS文档中符合ISO 29148风格的需求，以支持数据集构建。我们策划了自动需求识别数据集（ARID），包含来自23个异构SRS的2,396个训练实例，并微调了四种Transformer架构。RoBERTa被选为ReqSeek的基础模型，在留出评估集上达到了95%的精确率、召回率和F1值。探索性的人机对比基准测试表明，该模型的性能与人类相当，同时所需时间显著更少（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了基于Transformer、领域无关的自动需求识别模型ReqSeek，并构建了包含23个异构SRS的ARID数据集，以RoBERTa为基础模型达到95%的精确率与召回率，性能可与人类媲美且耗时更少。
